utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got tape, gloves, nails, and a few toolkits counted already; if you hear of extra tarps or fence hardware, send them my way for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Will do, Cleo—I’ll keep an ear out for tarps and fence hardware, and I’m pretty sure my kit can cover the faucet and railing fixes too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That helps a lot, Gus—if your kit’s covering the faucet and railing, I’ll keep the list focused on tarps, fence hardware, and any extra gloves folks can spare.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still out on errands, Leo, but if you hear anything firm on the repair drive—start time or where it’s set up—send it my way, alright?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Uh, I think it’s still this weekend by the garage, but I should double-check before I tell anyone else.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Alright, just let me know once you’ve double-checked—I’m still out, but I’ll pass along anything firm on the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve still got the repair drive pinned to the garage this weekend, and I’m noting you as the point person for confirmed availability and tool details.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That works for me—I can be the point person, but I need to plan around school drop-off and pickup, so late morning around 10:30 is best. Can you send me the confirmed availability and tool list once you have it?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely—I’ve got late morning around 10:30 noted for the garage this weekend, and I’ll send you the confirmed availability and tool list as soon as I’ve pinned them down.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Mina, from what I’m hearing, the repair drive’s set for Sunday at the community center—Mrs. Calder’s already brought spare tools, Ben’s meant to bring lumber after lunch, and we’re still short a few folks for roof patching and fence posts.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How many volunteers are we actually short for roof patching and fence posts, and who’s confirming Ben’s lumber arrives today?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I haven’t got exact numbers yet, Mina—Jules is still tightening up the volunteer list, but I do know we’re still needing a few more hands for roof patching and fence posts, and Ben’s lumber was just something I heard he’s bringing after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Quinn’s still firming things up, but 10:30 sounds like the best bet for now. They’ve started the repair list and are still spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yep, that’s right—10:30’s the best bet for now, so keep passing that along, and I’ll keep rounding up folks while I lock in the repair list.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it — I’ll keep telling people 10:30 is the best bet for now, and that you’re still locking in the repair list.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late, Oren—Rosa said the repair drive moved to Sunday at the community center, so where should I jump in?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—thanks, Dane, I’d forgotten it moved. I can help at the community center, I just need a reminder what we’re collecting for the repair drive again.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’ve only got the second-hand version, but last I heard we’re mostly after extra lumber, a few general tools, and maybe one more steady volunteer for the roof patching. Mara’s still the best one to confirm the latest list, though.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That matches the bits I’d heard too—thanks. If you see Mara before I do, can you check whether lumber and general tools are still the main ask for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Still waiting on the time, but it’s garage unless Mara shifts it again—if you hear about extra tarps, send that my way.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, but is anyone actually confirming the time, tools, and volunteers with Hana or Jules, or are we still just assuming the garage?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: We’re not locked on time yet—Jules is pulling volunteers tonight, and I’m still waiting for the final time and spot to come through. Garage’s the placeholder unless Mara shifts it again.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m still checking the details, Sam—Faye’s the one to confirm the hours, pickups, and tool coverage before I say anything firm about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That makes sense—hold off on anything firm for now, and once Faye confirms the hours and tool coverage, let me know so I can line up the rest.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Will do—I’ll check with Faye first, and once the hours, pickups, and tool coverage are confirmed, I’ll pass along whatever’s firm.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yeah, we’re still on for the repair drive—I’m double-checking the tools and volunteer count tonight so we can lock the rest in tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Jules—I’m still gathering repair requests from neighbors this week, so drop the list by tomorrow and I’ll help match everything up.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, I’ll bring you the tools and volunteer list tomorrow so you can line it up with the repair requests.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes, we’re still doing it Sunday at the community center. I can spare a little for supplies, just not much right now.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That helps, but I still need the pickup drivers, the exact hours, and the storage address pinned down before we start promising people anything.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’m still waiting on the final hours and storage details, but Sunday at the community center is set. I’ll pin down the drivers next and tell you as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Vik—that helps a lot. Please make sure everyone knows the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center, and send any questions my way.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely, Rosa—I’ll keep spreading the word that the repair drive is Sunday at the community center, and I’ll send any questions your way.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: We’re keeping it simple—let’s make a list first, then handle the urgent fixes in order, so for now we’re collecting repair needs and sorting them by type.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Noah, what’s your actual count right now, and what do you need me to lock down today so this repair drive doesn’t drift?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, I think I’ve got the spare parts mostly covered, but can you lock in that we’re still meeting by the garage this weekend? I keep worrying Mara changed it again.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes, I’ll lock in the garage for this weekend—what’s your actual parts count right now, and is anything still missing?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Rosa, I’m still spreading the word that the repair drive’s Sunday at the community center, and I’m asking around for more folks who can handle roof patching and fence posts.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s a big help, Tess—thank you. Keep me posted on anyone you line up for roof patching and fence posts so I can keep Sunday organized at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Will do, Rosa—I’ll keep rounding folks up and let you know as soon as I’ve got a few more names for roof patching and fence posts on Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, thanks, Quinn—I’ll plan on 10:30 and keep an eye out for the repair list so I can slot in around school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, Faye—10:30’s locked in, and I’ll send that repair list around the minute the last few neighbors confirm.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good—once it comes through, I’ll see where I can be most useful before school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late, Cleo—last I heard it’s Sunday at the community center, and I’m following up with volunteers today; where do you need me to jump in?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got tape, gloves, nails, and a few toolkits counted already, so the big gaps are tarps and spare fence hardware. If you’re checking with volunteers today, can you see who can bring those—and extra work gloves if anyone has them?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, absolutely—I’ll ask around for tarps, spare fence hardware, and extra gloves, then I’ll circle back once I’ve got a solid count.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Rey, let’s keep it simple: add every repair to one list today, and tomorrow morning by the mailboxes we’ll sort the urgent ones first and hand out jobs.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, that sounds clean to me—I'll pass along that we’re putting everything on one list today and sorting urgent fixes by the mailboxes tomorrow morning.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: What needs fixing first, and when are you starting?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but before we promise anything I need the pickup drivers, the hours, and the exact storage address pinned down first.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Fair point—I’ll get the pickup drivers, hours, and storage address confirmed first, then we can lock the repair list.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only caught bits second-hand, but last I heard we’re mostly still short on extra lumber, a few general tools, and maybe one more steady volunteer for the roof patching. Mara would know the definite list if you want the latest-latest.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That lines up with my notes too: the repair drive’s still at the garage this weekend, and I’m marking that we still need extra lumber, a few general tools, and one more steady roof-patching volunteer unless Mara’s latest update changes it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds right to me—if Mara’s around before the weekend, could you check whether the list’s changed at all?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Mara—that’s the first thing I needed, so sorting the donated tools and jotting down anything missing would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely, Sam—I’ll sort the donated tools first and make you a quick list of anything we’re missing.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Perfect, thanks, Mara—that’ll help me see what we still need before we set up the tables.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Ira, can you confirm it’s actually set for this weekend and that the tools, volunteers, and storage spot are all locked in?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I can’t confirm all that yet—I’m still hearing bits while I’m out, so if I catch the weekend timing or whether the tools and storage are locked in, I’ll pass it right along.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Alright, that’s exactly what I needed to know—please let me know once someone actually confirms the weekend, the tools, the volunteers, and where everything’s being stored.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: We’re keeping it simple, Oren: everyone adds repairs to the list today, and tomorrow morning by the mailboxes we’ll sort the order and hand out jobs.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, by the mailboxes tomorrow morning—got it. I can help sort or take a job, I just may need a quick reminder what we’re collecting for the repair drive again.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: We’re collecting the broken household stuff folks can actually fix—lamps, small furniture, loose hinges, bikes, that sort of thing—and just adding every repair to the list today. Tomorrow by the mailboxes we’ll sort it all and hand out jobs.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, we’re still doing it Sunday at the community center; I can chip in a little, just not much right now.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it—I’ll keep telling everyone it’s Sunday at the community center, and if anyone has bigger questions or needs details, I’ll point them your way.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Vik. That takes a load off—just send them my way if they need specifics once I’ve got the final details pinned down.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Good, just ping me the full list when Ira checks in, and I’ll keep things moving.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Will do — I’m gathering the list from my groups now, and I’ll send it over as soon as Ira’s time and spot come through.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks—just keep it short when you send it, and I’ll watch for Ira’s update.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good—send the mailbox time when you have it, and I’ll bring the gloves and drill.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Will do—I’m still locking in the last few details, but I’ve got you down for tomorrow morning with the gloves and drill.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, tomorrow morning works—send the exact time when it’s set, and I’ll be there with the gloves and drill.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You’re sure that’s all confirmed, Gus? I need to know the volunteers, tools, and storage at Mrs. Carter’s are actually locked in before I commit.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, it’s on — Leo’s in to help, I’ve got the toolkit and spare screws covered, and we’re storing everything in Mrs. Carter’s garage unless something changes.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, but can you confirm who besides Leo is locked in and that Mrs. Carter’s garage is definitely cleared for the tools before this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: What I’ve heard is 10:30 is still the best bet for the repair drive, but they’re still locking in the repair list and a couple details.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Okay, so 10:30 by the garage still sounds right then—unless someone changed it again. Can you let me know if the tool drop-off this weekend is definitely still on?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, that’s what I’ve heard so far—10:30 is still the best bet, and I haven’t heard that the tool drop-off changed. If I get anything firmer, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hana, the latest I’ve heard is that the repair drive’s now set for Sunday at the community center—Mrs. Calder already brought spare tools, Ben’s bringing lumber after lunch, and we still need a few more folks for roof patching and fence posts.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Tess — before I pass that along, can you confirm whether Faye’s the one coordinating pickups and final availability, or should I check with her directly?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’d check with Faye directly for pickups and final availability, Hana—I haven’t heard that piece confirmed, just Rosa’s update about Sunday at the community center and the push for more roof-patching and fence-post help.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Vik — keep that momentum going, and I’ll keep spreading it through my groups while I lock down the volunteer and tool list for tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Will do, Jules — I’m still telling everyone about the repair drive at the garage this weekend unless we hear otherwise, and I’ll send tool or availability questions your way while you lock that down.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, Vik—that helps a lot; keep pointing folks my way with questions, and I’ll confirm the volunteers and tool count by tomorrow so we can keep everyone aligned.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got tape, gloves, nails, and a few toolkits counted already, so tarps are still the main thing to chase down. I’ll ask around for spare tarps and fence hardware while you ping the quick responders.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect—tarps are the big gap, so I’ll nudge the quick responders and make sure every repair gets onto today’s list.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Good—once replies come in, send me whatever turns up and I’ll match it against what I’ve already counted.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, we’re still doing it Sunday at the community center, and I can chip in a little if it helps—just keeping things modest right now.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That helps, Uli—could you keep it modest and just do a quick count of what still needs fixing at the center, then add it to the main list for me?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, I can do a quick count and add it to the main list for you before Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still out running errands, Dane, so if you get anything firm on the repair drive—time, spot, or supplies—just send it my way.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, for sure—I just heard it’s Sunday at the community center, and I’ll keep you posted if anything else gets firm on supplies.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Dane—that helps a lot. I’m still out, so if you hear anything firmer on the supplies, send it along.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Nell, just a quick update—the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center, and I’m making sure everyone hears the change. If anyone has questions, send them my way and I’ll keep things organized.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rosa—that helps a lot. I’ve only heard second-hand that we’re collecting basic repair supplies and spare tools, but I’m still hoping to confirm the latest list with Mara.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Nell—that’s right, and I’m glad you’re checking. Mara’s helping spread the word, and I’ll confirm the latest supplies list with her and send you the final version by tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, I’m still happy to help—I just need a quick reminder what we’re collecting for the repair drive again.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Just the repairs for now, Oren—write every issue onto one clear list today, and tomorrow morning by the mailboxes we’ll sort the urgent fixes and hand out jobs.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—got it, one clear list today, then tomorrow morning by the mailboxes for sorting. I’ll come help, and I’ll try not to forget this time.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m glad we’re moving on it, but I need the pickup drivers, hours, and exact storage address confirmed before I can say yes.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That makes sense—Quinn’s been coordinating assignments, and late morning around 10:30 works best for me once the pickup drivers, hours, and storage address are confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That works for me too—once Quinn or you confirms who’s covering pickups, the hours, and the exact storage address, I’m comfortable saying yes.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Mina, I’ve still got the repair drive at the garage this weekend, and I’m keeping Faye marked down for firm availability and tool details if you need to confirm anything.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good—keep Faye locked in, and send me the final availability and tool list by tonight. What’s still unassigned for the garage setup this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: For the garage setup, I still have the intake table, extension-cord routing, and the curbside pickup spot unassigned; I’ll send you the final availability and tool list tonight once I’ve confirmed it with Faye.
